lemma: Window bookkeeping (conditional). Let N = 2^n, threshold s = N^beta, and suppose CC(MCSP[N^beta]) <= C0*N^theta. Suppose a simulation L(f) <= C*CC(f)^q holds for the MMW-derived families. Then every probabilistic formula for MCSP[N^beta] has size <= C*C0^q*N^(q*theta). CJW20 Thm 1.6 (verbatim from the ledger source check: for every alpha in (0,1) and eps>0, MCSP[n^alpha] has no probabilistic n^(2+alpha-eps)-size formulas) gives size >= N^(2+beta-eps). The two bounds contradict iff q*theta < 2+beta-eps. Necessary condition: theta < (2+beta)/q as eps -> 0.

proved_step: Depth-leaf bound (restricted, shrinks G0001). Let C be a fan-in-2 DAG over inputs x_1..x_n with s gates and depth d (inputs have depth 0). Its full unfolding, the tree obtained by duplicating every shared node, is a formula F_C computing the same function, and F_C has at most 2^d leaves. Proof by induction on depth: an input has 1 = 2^0 leaf; a gate v of depth k has inputs a,b of depth at most k-1, so L(v) = L(a)+L(b) <= 2*2^(k-1) = 2^k. Corollary: if d <= c*log2(s) then |F_C| <= s^c, a fixed-exponent simulation. Scope: this is the only fixed-q case proved here; it covers depth O(log s) only and does NOT close G0001, since MMW-derived families have depth poly(s).
